extDescription.message: The StartPOZI Browser's privacy protection in any browser: ad & tracker blocking, cookie-banner auto-decline, URL cleaning, DNT+GPC, anti-fingerprinting. Private StartPOZI search included.

secIntro.message: Privacy and security protection settings while browsing sites.

dUrlClean.message: Remove tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, etc.) from links

dCookies.message: Automatically click "Reject / Decline / Reject all" on cookie consent dialogs and hide them. "Accept" is never clicked

dDnt.message: Send the DNT signal to websites

tGpc.message: Tell websites not to sell or share my data

dGpc.message: Global Privacy Control (GPC): sends the Sec-GPC: 1 header and navigator.globalPrivacyControl. A request signal, not a blocker — some sites may ignore it

dReferrer.message: Send only the origin (without the full path) when navigating between sites

d3pCookies.message: Strip Set-Cookie from third-party tracker responses

dMixed.message: Block HTTP resources on HTTPS pages (mixed content)

dHttps.message: Upgrade navigations from HTTP to HTTPS (may break HTTP-only sites)

dPing.message: Fire-and-forget click-tracking pings never leave the browser

fpIntro.message: Resistance to browser fingerprinting — the same protections as the StartPOZI Browser.

dFpShield.message: Always-on value noise: Canvas, CPU/RAM values, Battery API, sendBeacon, media devices, screen depth, local font list. Does not change your User-Agent

dAudioFp.message: Adds inaudible micro-noise to Web Audio data reads (silent tones used for tracking). Does not affect playback

dWebGL.message: Spoof GPU and graphics card info to protect against tracking

dWebRTC.message: Blocks WebRTC leaks — your local IP cannot escape, even under VPN

dIdentity.message: Freezes navigator.platform, normalizes languages and adds AudioContext noise. Opt-in — like in the browser

permIntro.message: Automatically deny intrusive permission prompts (Chromium only).

dNotif.message: Automatically reject site requests to send notifications

dGeo.message: Deny sites access to your location

sitesIntro.message: Sites where all protection is paused (like the browser's per-site shield toggle).

noExceptions.message: No exceptions. Turn protection off for a site from the toolbar popup.

fhIntro.message: Blocklist catalog from the FilterHub repository. Not all lists are enabled by default: the recommended Medium set is on.

savedRestartHint.message: Saved. Reload open tabs to apply.

csIntro.message: CSS rules to hide elements on sites. Format: domain { CSS } or { CSS } for all sites

dPersistLog.message: Off by default: the log lives in memory only and is wiped on exit

searchIntro.message: The extension registers the private StartPOZI search (no telemetry, no tracking) as a search engine.

guideChromium.message: right-click the address bar → Search engines → Manage search engines → find StartPOZI → "Make default". Chrome may ask for confirmation when an extension registers a search engine — confirm once.

guideFf.message: the extension sets StartPOZI as the default search engine automatically during installation (can be changed in Settings → Search).

aboutText.message: StartPOZI Privacy Guard brings the StartPOZI Browser's protection to any Chromium or Firefox browser: ad & tracker blocking with FilterHub lists, automatic cookie-banner rejection, URL cleaning, DNT + GPC, and anti-fingerprinting — all local, zero telemetry.
